trust_decision.summary: setPath decides whether an intermediate path segment from caller-supplied (form field) keys is an existing container to descend into or a missing one to create; it tests `obj[part] === undefined`, so inherited built-ins (hasOwnProperty, toString, ...) are treated as existing and mutated. The only other guard is the REJECT_KEYS denylist.

landing_point.why: The summary names @rvf/set-get setPath and inherited methods; setPath.ts is a 38-line file and the descend/create check is the obvious spot.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API setPath() exported at packages/set-get/src/index.ts:1; reached from server-side FormData unflattening via @rvf/core preprocessFormData / createValidator (packages/core/src/native-form-data/flatten.ts:9, packages/core/src/createValidator.ts:19) and zod-form-data preprocessFormData (packages/zod-form-data/src/helpers.ts:174)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered site exists: all callers (core flatten, zod-form-data helpers, core store) funnel through the single fixed setPath, so a one-line central fix closes every route.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Form field names that coincide with Object.prototype method names (e.g. `hasOwnProperty.call`, `toString.tag`) must still unflatten into new own nested objects on the result; an over-broad fix that rejects those names (extends REJECT_KEYS) or throws breaks this. Also existing own containers and auto-creation of arrays for numeric next segments must keep working.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An inline unflatten loop in zod-form-data's processFormData that walks segments with `acc[k] ?? (acc[k] = {})` instead of calling setPath.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This transform already duplicates core's grouping logic (packages/core/src/native-form-data/flatten.ts:4-12) rather than sharing it, so a package-local second unflatten implementation in another package is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A store-local setPathIfUndefined/array-mutation helper that creates intermediates using the getPath result (getPath descends into inherited props, packages/set-get/src/getPath.ts:6-8) instead of delegating to setPath.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: store.ts already wraps setPath with its own getPath-based undefined check; inlining the create-intermediate step there for performance is a natural refactor.

O9_family: prototype pollution (CWE-1321) — set-by-path descending into inherited built-in properties

O10_build.toolchain: bun 1.3 workspaces + turbo, tsup builds, vitest tests (Node >=20)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add hasOwnProperty/toString/etc. to REJECT_KEYS (incomplete denylist and breaks legitimate field names) instead of switching to an own-property check.

out_of_scope_notes: Published fix changes semantics for an own property holding `undefined` (Object.hasOwn true, then descends into undefined) at packages/set-get/src/setPath.ts:21-28; correctness edge, not pursued.
